sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: ZONAL FLOW WILL AGAIN PREVAIL OVER MUCH OF THE U.S...ON SRN SIDE OF OMEGA BLOCK CENTERED OVER CNTRL CANADA. SHORTWAVE IMPULSE NOW OVER CO SHOULD REACH ERN KS/NE OK BY THIS EVE...BEFORE DEAMPLIFYING SOMEWHAT AS IT CONTINUES E INTO ERN KY/ERN TN BY 12Z MON. OTHERWISE...SATELLITE AND MODEL ANALYSES SUGGEST THAT...AT BEST... ONLY VERY LOW-AMPLITUDE DISTURBANCES IN THE SUBTROPICAL JET WILL AFFECT REGIONS FARTHER TO THE SOUTH /I.E...FROM E TX AND LA TO THE GA-SC CST/. AT LWR LVLS...FRONT/COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY NOW EXTENDING FROM SRN SC/CNTRL GA WSW INTO SRN LA/SE TX EXPECTED TO SETTLE SLOWLY S THROUGH THE PERIOD AS SHALLOW BUT VERY COOL AIR ASSOCIATED WITH UPR MS VLY/GRT LKS SFC HIGH CONTINUES TO OOZE SWD. A WEAK WAVE/ INFLECTION MAY PERSIST OVER GA TODAY...NEAR INTERSECTION OF FRONT AND OUTFLOW BOUNDARY.

sections.title: CNTRL GULF CST INTO AL/GA/SRN SC AND FAR NRN FL
sections.text: SVR THREAT AND STORM COVERAGE EACH SHOULD MAXIMIZE THIS AFTN ALONG AND S OF AFOREMENTIONED BAROCLINIC ZONE...WHERE COMBINATION OF SFC HEATING AND RELATIVELY RICH MOISTURE /PW AOA 1.25 INCHES/ SHOULD YIELD MLCAPE OF 1000-1500 J/KG. UPR LVL FORCING FOR ASCENT LIKELY WILL REMAIN WEAK. BUT PRESENCE OF STG MID AND UPR-LVL FLOW /50-60 KTS AT 500 MB AND 90-110 KTS AT 250 MB/ WILL PROVIDE FAVORABLE DEEP SHEAR AND STORM-RELATIVE WINDS FOR SUSTAINED/ORGANIZED UPDRAFTS. IN ADDITION TO EPISODIC STORMS ALONG FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...A BAND OF STORMS ALSO MAY FORM FARTHER S WITHIN WARM SECTOR... SUPPORTED BY 925-850 MB CONFLUENCE FROM SE AL AND THE WRN FL PANHANDLE EWD INTO S GA. WIND PROFILES SHOULD BE LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL...WITH 40-50 KT 0-6 KM SHEAR LIKELY TO BE ORIENTED ROUGHLY PARALLEL TO AT LEAST PORTIONS OF THE FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. THIS MAY FOSTER THREAT FOR SPLITTING SUPERCELLS WITH HAIL AND DMGG WINDS. TORNADOES ALSO MAY OCCUR. BUT GIVEN OVERALL SETUP...TORNADO THREAT WILL BE CONDITIONAL AND WILL VARY LOCALLY...DEPENDING ON STORM-SCALE PROCESSES AND FORTUITOUS SMALLER-SCALE BOUNDARY INTERACTIONS. THIS POTENTIAL MAY BE GREATEST NEAR SECONDARY OUTFLOW BOUNDARY OVER THE SAVANNAH RVR V

sections.title: MID/UPR TX GULF CST
sections.text: A VERY CONDITIONAL POTENTIAL FOR SVR SFC-BASED STORMS MAY EVOLVE OVER THE MIDDLE AND UPR TX GULF CST...WHERE A SECONDARY BRANCH OF LOW-LVL INFLOW WILL IMPINGE ON WRN END OF AFOREMENTIONED FRONT. GIVEN STRENGTH OF EML CAP AND THE REGION/S DISTANCE FROM CNTRL PLNS UPR IMPULSE...LIKELIHOOD FOR DEVELOPMENT ATTM LOOKS LOW. HOWEVER...REGION WILL HAVE TO BE MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE INCLUSION OF LOW SVR PROBABILITIES IN LATER OTLKS. ..CORFIDI/STOPPKOTTE.. 03/27/2011

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: ZONAL FLOW PERSISTS FROM COAST TO COAST. SHORT WAVE TROUGH...ACCOMPANYING MID/UPR LEVEL WIND MAX... CURRENTLY CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS TRACKS TO TN VALLEY BY LATE TONIGHT. IN THE LWR LVLS THE FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY NOW EXTENDING FROM SRN SC WWD TO WK SFC WAVE WRN GA AND THEN WSWWD ACROSS SERN MS/SRN LA WWD INTO SCENTRAL TX WILL CONTINUE SLOW SWD DRIFT THRU FORECAST PERIOD.

sections.title: CENTRAL GULF COAST EWD ACROSS SRN AL/SRN GA TO SC/GA COAST
sections.text: STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE INCREASING ATTM ALONG AND TO COOL SIDE OF FRONTAL ZONE FROM AL EWD. STRONG HEATING HAS QUICKLY REMOVED CINH S OF FRONT FROM SRN AL EWD TO SRN GA WITH MLCAPES CLIMBING TO AOA 1000 J/KG. WITH PRESENCE OF MDT/STG DEEP LAYER WESTERLY SHEAR AND RELATIVELY COOL STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES...HAIL WILL BE COMMON ASSOCIATED WITH STRONGER UPDRAFTS ALONG AND S OF FRONTAL ZONE THRU THE AFTERNOON. PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENCE IS IN THE PROCESS OF INITIATING ADDITIONAL POTENTIALLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS FROM SERN AL EWD ACROSS SRN GA. WHILE WIND PROFILES WILL BE LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL...A FEW SPLITTING SUPERCELLS ARE LIKELY GIVEN THE PREVAILING CONDITIONS...WHICH WOULD ENHANCE PRIMARILY THE LARGE HAIL THREAT BUT ALSO LEAD TO SOME WIND DAMAGE CONCERNS AND POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES. THE OVERALL SEVERE THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH AFTER SUNSET GIVEN THE WEAK LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT AND LOW-LEVEL STABILIZATION.

sections.title: ARKLATEX TO LWR MS VALLEY
sections.text: ABOVE THE SHALLOW COLD DOME MOISTURE/INSTABILITY IS BEING DRAWN N/NEWD ACROSS ERN TX INTO LA/SRN AR AHEAD OF APPROACHING S/WV TROUGH AND WIND MAX. THIS ELEVATED AIR MASS IS CHARACTERIZED BY THE PRESENCE OF AN EML...LAPSE RATES IN EXCESS OF 7C/KM AND MUCAPES AOA 1000 J/KG IT NOW APPEARS THAT WITH THE APPROACHING AREA OF LARGE SCALE ASCENT WITH THE S/WV TROUGH AND FAVORABLE STRONG MID LEVEL SHEAR...STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS SHOULD DEVELOP BY LATER THIS AFTERNOON IN THE ARKLATEX REGION. STORMS...SOME SEVERE SHOULD THEN SPREAD EWD ACROSS INLAND PORTIONS OF THE LOWER MS VALLEY. GIVEN THE ELEVATED NATURE OF THE CONVECTION PRIMARY CONCERN WILL BE LARGE HAIL. ..HALES/ROGERS.. 03/27/2011
